units.source_text: 紫姬为源氏公子制办旅中衣物。

en.t: Lady Murasaki prepared traveling clothes for Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 无纹硬绸的常礼服和裙子，样子异乎寻常，看了令人悲叹。

en.t: The plain stiff silk formal robes and skirts looked strangely unlike ordinary garments, and the sight of them filled one with sorrow.

units.source_text: 临别吟唱“镜影随君永不离”时的面影，始终留在紫姬眼前，然而空花泡影，有何裨益？

en.t: The image of him as he chanted at parting, The mirror's reflection will follow you and never leave, remained always before Lady Murasaki's eyes, yet it was only an empty illusion, of what use could it be?

units.source_text: 看到公子往时出入的门户、常凭的罗汉松木柱，胸中总是郁结。

en.t: Whenever she saw the gates through which the prince had once come and gone, or the podocarpus pillar against which he had often leaned, her heart was always choked with grief.

units.source_text: 阅世甚深而惯于尘劳的老年人，对此情景也不免悲伤。

en.t: Even old people who had seen much of the world and were used to its hardships could not help grieving at this scene.

units.source_text: 何况紫姬从小亲近公子，视同父母，全靠他抚养成人。

en.t: How much more so Lady Murasaki, who had been close to the prince since childhood, regarded him as father and mother, and had depended entirely on him to raise her to adulthood.

units.source_text: 一旦匆匆别去，其恋慕之殷，自属理之当然。

en.t: Once he had hurriedly gone away from her, it was only natural that her longing for him should be so deep.

units.source_text: 假令索性死了，则无法挽回，这是不言而喻，且过后也渐渐遗忘。

en.t: If he had simply died, then it would go without saying that nothing could be done, and in time even that would gradually be forgotten.

units.source_text: 但如今并不是死，而是流放，其地虽然离京不远，但别离年限无定，归期渺茫难知。

en.t: But now he was not dead; he had been exiled. Although the place was not far from the capital, the term of separation was uncertain, and the date of his return was remote and impossible to know.

units.source_text: 如此一想，便有无穷悲愤。

en.t: When she thought of it in this way, endless grief and indignation welled up within her.
